stories.title: Dow scores its best day in 18 months in a broad relief rally after Democrats sweep to power in Congress
stories.summary: Stocks surged, oil prices plunged and bond yields fell Wednesday on optimism around a quicker end to the Iran war now that Democrats have clinched control of Congress.
stories.zh_title: 民主黨在國會上台後，道瓊指數在廣泛的救濟性反彈中創下 18 個月來的最佳單日表現
stories.zh_summary: 由於民主黨已經控制了國會，人們對伊朗戰爭更快結束感到樂觀，週三股市飆升，油價暴跌，債券殖利率下跌。

stories.title: Most investors are blind to the possibility of a market crash. Here is the five-part strategy to survive one.
stories.summary: Wall Street veteran Jared Dillian says the biggest problem is many investors these days have not lived through a major downturn. He’s got a portfolio that offers protection.
stories.zh_title: 大多數投資者對市場崩盤的可能性視而不見。這是生存策略的五部分。
stories.zh_summary: 華爾街資深人士賈里德·迪利安(Jared Dillian)表示，最大的問題是如今許多投資者還沒有經歷過嚴重的低迷時期。他有一個可以提供保護的投資組合。

stories.title: From tanks to drones: South Korea’s defense firms face a new battlefield test
stories.summary: South Korean defense stocks rode a wave of global rearmament for the past two years, but they have plunged in 2026.
stories.zh_title: 從坦克車到無人機：韓國國防企業面臨新的戰場考驗
stories.zh_summary: 過去兩年，韓國國防股經歷了全球重新軍備浪潮，但在 2026 年出現暴跌。

stories.title: Hyperscalers and Apple surge after election results remove investor uncertainty
stories.summary: Apple, Amazon, Google, Meta and Microsoft stock was up after the midterms, while stocks tied to Trump advisor Elon Musk and data centers fell on Wednesday.
stories.zh_title: 選舉結果消除了投資者的不確定性後，超大規模企業和蘋果股價飆升
stories.zh_summary: 蘋果、亞馬遜、谷歌、Meta 和微軟的股票在中期選舉後上漲，而與川普顧問馬斯克和數據中心相關的股票週三下跌。

stories.title: ChatGPT will now make you animated GIFs
stories.summary: ChatGPT can now create GIFs using a prompt or a photo uploaded to the AI chatbot. The update, which is rolling out alongside OpenAI's new Images 2.6 model, allows you to adjust the GIF's animation speed, edit individual frames, and share it with others. Before this change, ChatGPT couldn't natively generate GIFs in a single […]
stories.zh_title: ChatGPT 現在將為您製作動畫 GIF
stories.zh_summary: ChatGPT 現在可以使用提示或上傳到 AI 聊天機器人的照片來建立 GIF。該更新與 OpenAI 的新 Images 2.6 模型一起推出，讓您可以調整 GIF 的動畫速度、編輯單個幀並與其他人分享。在此更改之前，ChatGPT 本身無法

stories.title: This year’s worst-performing S&P 500 stock is finally seeing some major relief
stories.summary: AppLovin’s stock is popping after “clearly positive” earnings results.
stories.zh_title: 今年表現最差的標普 500 指數股票終於出現一些重大緩解
stories.zh_summary: 在「明顯積極」的獲利結果之後，AppLovin 的股價正在上漲。

stories.title: Qualcomm is betting big on data centers as smartphone sales sink
stories.summary: With smartphone sales tanking by around 20 percent compared to 2025, Qualcomm is looking to data centers to help boost its bottom line. During its Q4 2026 earnings call, the company laid out its plans to make a splash in the AI data center business, through partnerships with companies like Amazon and Meta announced earlier […]
stories.zh_title: 隨著智慧型手機銷量下滑，高通在資料中心上下了重註
stories.zh_summary: 與 2025 年相比，智慧型手機銷量將下降約 20%，高通正在尋求資料中心來幫助提高其利潤。在 2026 年第四季財報電話會議上，該公司製定了透過與亞馬遜等公司合作，在人工智慧資料中心業務引起轟動的計劃。

stories.title: These stocks soared the most today after the Democrats trounced Trump
stories.summary: Chemical company Mosaic’s stock is the strongest performer among the S&P 500, while several tech players and associated power providers show sharp declines
stories.zh_title: 民主黨擊敗川普後，這些股票今天漲幅最大
stories.zh_summary: 化學公司 Mosaic 的股票是標準普爾 500 指數中表現最強的股票，而幾家科技公司和相關電力提供商的股票則大幅下跌

stories.title: Meta acquires AI coding startup Conductor
stories.summary: The startup allows software engineers to deploy teams of agents to work on various aspects of a project simultaneously.
stories.zh_title: Meta 收購人工智慧編碼新創公司 Conductor
stories.zh_summary: 該新創公司允許軟體工程師部署代理團隊，同時處理專案的各個方面。

stories.title: Apple is reportedly cutting budgets for its internal AI usage
stories.summary: The company is said to be significantly dropping the amount it's spending on AI for its engineering teams.
stories.zh_title: 據報道，蘋果正在削減內部人工智慧使用的預算
stories.zh_summary: 據稱，該公司將大幅削減其工程團隊在人工智慧方面的支出。

stories.title: Snap shares fall over 10% on third-quarter revenue miss
stories.summary: Snap misses on revenue and daily active users in third-quarter earnings reported Wednesday.
stories.zh_title: Snap 股價因第三季營收未達預期而下跌超過 10%
stories.zh_summary: Snap 在周三公佈的第三季財報中，營收和每日活躍用戶數均未達預期。

stories.title: Nothing CEO says company’s mysterious AI-first device is dropping next month
stories.summary: While it's not yet clear what kind of product the smartphone startup is cooking up, Nothing's CEO said the product is designed to leverage AI for productivity gains.
stories.zh_title: 執行長表示公司神秘的人工智慧優先設備將於下個月發布
stories.zh_summary: 雖然目前尚不清楚這家智慧型手機新創公司正在開發什麼樣的產品，但 Nothing 的執行長表示，該產品旨在利用人工智慧來提高生產力。

stories.title: Almost no one uses AI agents to book their Uber, company says
stories.summary: During its busiest week last quarter, Uber said only four people booked a ride using an AI agent.
stories.zh_title: 該公司表示，幾乎沒有人使用人工智慧代理來預訂 Uber
stories.zh_summary: 優步表示，在上個季度最繁忙的一周內，只有四人使用人工智慧代理商預訂了行程。

stories.title: OpenAI is already trying to shape the 2028 election
stories.summary: OpenAI’s Chris Lehane wants AI to define the 2028 election, proposing a new social contract that could benefit Americans while also advancing the AI giant’s own business interests.
stories.zh_title: OpenAI 已經在嘗試塑造 2028 年選舉
stories.zh_summary: OpenAI 的 Chris Lehane 希望人工智慧能夠定義 2028 年的選舉，提出一項新的社會契約，既可以讓美國人受益，同時也可以促進人工智慧巨頭自身的商業利益。
